articles.title: U.S. Space Force Awards $17 Billion in Rocket Launch Contracts to Seven Companies

articles.title: South Korean AI Tool Reads a Single ECG to Flag Post-Surgery Death Risk, Study Finds
articles.excerpt: Researchers at Seoul National University Bundang Hospital analyzed over 41,000 patients and found that an AI-enhanced electrocardiogram could classify 92 percent of surgical candidates as low-risk, potentially eliminating unnecessary cardiac testing.
articles.image_caption: An ECG heart monitor displaying cardiac rhythm data in a hospital. The South Korean AI tool analyzes standard 12-lead ECG images to predict post-surgical mortality risk.
articles.nri_angle: The AI-ECG research offers a potential model for India's rapidly growing hospital networks, where preoperative cardiac testing is common and health-tech companies are developing similar platforms.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SpaceX Stock Hits Record Low After Seven Straight Days of Losses

articles.image_caption: Image: @mymixtapez via X

articles.title: Federal Judge Blocks $110 Billion Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger in Antitrust Win for States

articles.nri_angle: The $110 billion merger between two major Hollywood studios could reshape the entertainment landscape, affecting content production and streaming options for global audiences.

articles.title: Hyderabad Engineer Uday Ruddarraju Named OpenAI's Chief Technology Officer of Compute
articles.excerpt: The Indian-origin executive, who built xAI's Colossus supercomputer before joining OpenAI last year, will lead the infrastructure powering GPT-5.6 and future AI models.
articles.image_caption: Uday Ruddarraju has been promoted to CTO of Compute at OpenAI. The Hyderabad-born engineer previously built xAI's Colossus supercomputer before joining OpenAI in July 2025.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin engineer from Hyderabad rises to a top leadership position at OpenAI, extending a pattern of Indian-origin executives leading global tech companies.

articles.nri_angle: The ruling has implications for digital communications across India and raises concerns among the diaspora about the government's expanding authority over messaging platforms they rely on to stay connected with family.

articles.title: Samsung Launches Galaxy Card to Take On Apple in US Credit Card Market

articles.title: Honor's Robot Phone Steals the Spotlight at World Cup Final With Moving Camera

articles.nri_angle: Honor's ambitious smartphone design, developed in partnership with German cinema company ARRI, signals how Chinese tech innovation is pushing boundaries in mobile photography — a market where Indian consumers are among the world's largest.

articles.title: NVIDIA Researchers Build AI Detector That Spots Fake Videos With Over 90% Accuracy in Milliseconds

articles.title: Trump's AI Safety Agency Chief Resigns After Three Months as Indian-Origin Arvind Raman Takes the Helm

articles.title: India's ₹10 Lakh Crore Green Hydrogen Opportunity: The Missing Link in the Energy Transition
articles.excerpt: From electrolysers to export terminals, India's National Green Hydrogen Mission is unlocking a massive investment wave — but key gaps in infrastructure and cost competitiveness remain.

articles.title: Indian IT Giants Shift Spending to AI and BFSI as Macro Headwinds Stall Broader Growth
articles.excerpt: With discretionary budgets frozen and overall revenue growth stuck at 3-4%, India's Big Five IT firms are channelling investment into AI-led transformation, banking modernisation and cybersecurity — the few pockets where client spending still flows.
articles.image_caption: IT professionals at work in a technology services office. India's $315 billion IT sector is navigating a spending shift towards AI and banking modernisation as discretionary budgets remain frozen amid macro uncertainty.
articles.nri_angle: The shift towards AI, data engineering and cybersecurity skills directly affects career prospects for millions of Indian IT professionals both in India and across the diaspora, particularly in the US and UK.

articles.title: Air India Wins FlightGlobal Digital Leadership Award for Tech Transformation
articles.excerpt: The Tata-owned carrier takes the Digital Leadership prize at the 2026 Airline Strategy Awards in London, capping a $200 million technology overhaul that rebuilt its systems from scratch.
articles.image_caption: Airport terminal interior reflecting the modern infrastructure investments reshaping Indian aviation
articles.nri_angle: Air India’s $200 million tech rebuild under Tata ownership is producing tangible improvements in booking, check-in, and customer service that directly benefit NRI travelers on India-bound routes.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AMD Launches Helios AI Rack System as Microsoft Expands Azure Partnership
articles.excerpt: AMD's first rack-scale AI platform delivers 2.9 exaFLOPS per rack with 72 MI455X GPUs, while Microsoft adds three new Azure VM offerings powered by the system.
articles.image_caption: Server racks inside a modern data center. AMD's Helios platform houses 72 MI455X GPUs in a single double-wide rack designed for AI inference at scale.
articles.nri_angle: India's chip design centers in Hyderabad and Bangalore are core to both AMD's GPU architecture and Microsoft's Azure expansion, with the new India South Central Azure region in Hyderabad targeted for mid-2026 completion.

articles.title: Tech Mahindra Opens Consumer Agentic Experience Studio in Hyderabad

articles.nri_angle: Indian IT services companies are leading the global push into agentic AI, with implications for diaspora professionals in technology consulting and enterprise AI roles worldwide.

articles.title: Wipro Appoints Former Macy's Tech Leader Laura Miller to Board of Directors
articles.excerpt: Miller, who shaped digital and AI strategy at Macy's and holds board seats at NCR Voyix and Ahold Delhaize, joins Wipro for a five-year term effective April 2026.
articles.image_caption: Wipro's campus in Sarjapur, Bengaluru. The IT services giant has appointed Laura Marie Miller to its board of directors for a five-year term starting April 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Wipro is one of India's largest IT employers and a major presence in markets where the Indian diaspora works, including the United States and Europe. Miller's appointment from Wipro's East Brunswick, New Jersey headquarters underscores the company's deepening integration with American corporate leadership.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Work, an AI Agent That Manages Email, Slack, and Calendars Across Your Office

articles.image_caption: A professional working with AI-powered tools on a laptop screen. OpenAI's ChatGPT Work can now manage multi-step business tasks across connected office applications.
articles.nri_angle: Directly affects India's IT professionals: ChatGPT Work automates tasks performed by millions across India's technology services sector.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Targets $200 Billion in AI Infrastructure Investment by 2028
articles.excerpt: IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw unveiled an aggressive plan at the AI Impact Summit to position India as a global AI computing hub, backed by tax holidays through 2047, a ₹100 billion venture fund, and commitments from Amazon, Google, and Microsoft.
articles.image_caption: Server racks inside a data center facility. India aims to attract over $200 billion in AI infrastructure investment by 2028, including hyperscale data centers across the country.
articles.nri_angle: India's massive AI infrastructure push creates significant opportunities for NRI tech professionals and investors looking to participate in the country's AI buildout.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bezos-Backed CuspAI Raises $450 Million at $2.6 Billion Valuation to Discover New Chipmaking Materials
articles.excerpt: The Cambridge-based startup uses AI to simulate and discover materials for semiconductors and clean energy, with ASML, Meta, and Nvidia among its early customers.
articles.image_caption: A semiconductor fabrication facility. CuspAI is using artificial intelligence to discover new materials that could make chipmaking cheaper and less resource-intensive.
articles.nri_angle: India's semiconductor ambitions — including the $13.3 billion chip package and Tata-Micron fab projects — stand to benefit from breakthroughs in AI-driven materials discovery that could reshape global chip supply chains.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Menlo Ventures' Deedy Das Flags Scaling Cracks as Kimi K3 Buckles Under Its Own Weight
articles.excerpt: The world's largest open-weight AI model forced Moonshot to pause subscriptions within 48 hours of launch, spotlighting the fragile economics of trillion-parameter systems that Indian-origin investor Deedy Das and other Silicon Valley voices have warned about.
articles.image_caption: An abstract visualization of a microchip and its neural pathways. Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3, the world's largest open-weight AI model, was forced to pause new subscriptions within 48 hours of launch after demand overwhelmed its GPU infrastructure.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin Menlo Ventures partner Deedy Das, who grew up in Kolkata and is among Silicon Valley's youngest top-tier VCs, has been a leading voice questioning the sustainability of open-weight AI models at frontier scale.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Alibaba's Qwen Unveils Preview of Flagship AI Model That Rivals Anthropic
articles.excerpt: The 2.4-trillion-parameter Qwen3.8-Max, which Alibaba claims is second only to Anthropic's Fable 5, sent the company's stock up 5.6% and signals an accelerating AI race between China and the U.S.
articles.image_caption: Server racks inside a modern data center. Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max, a 2.4-trillion-parameter model, is the latest salvo in an intensifying AI race between Chinese and American labs.
articles.nri_angle: Open-weight Chinese AI models lower development costs for Indian startups, but enterprise adoption requires navigating geopolitical and compliance considerations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI-Powered Humanoid Robot 'Sally' to Teach New York Students — But Its Maker's Past Raises Eyebrows
articles.excerpt: Salamanca City Central School District in Western New York will deploy a $57,590 humanoid robot built by Realbotix, a company with roots in the adult entertainment industry, to teach STEM to 500 high school students this fall.
articles.image_caption: A humanoid robot with illuminated features demonstrates the kind of AI-driven technology entering classrooms. Salamanca City Central School District in New York will deploy a Realbotix humanoid robot named Sally to teach STEM to high school students this fall.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian-American families deeply invested in STEM education and the technology sector, the deployment of AI teaching assistants in U.S. public schools raises critical questions about educational quality, the role of technology in learning, and the future job landscape in the AI and robotics industries where Indian professionals are heavily represented.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Semiconductor Hiring Surges as AI Boom Widens the Door for Entry-Level Talent

articles.image_caption: A close-up of a semiconductor circuit board. The global chip industry is scrambling to fill over 150,000 positions as AI demand reshapes workforce requirements.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin engineers and students form a core pipeline for US semiconductor roles, and the AI-driven hiring surge creates both opportunities and visa complications.

articles.title: TSMC Pledges $100 Billion More for Arizona as AI Demand Drives Record Profit

articles.title: India Deploys 'White Rabbit' Technology to Secure Its National Time Network
articles.excerpt: A new demonstration network in Bengaluru uses precision timing technology originally developed at CERN to reduce India's dependence on foreign satellite systems like GPS.

articles.title: Chip Stocks Enter Bear Market, but BofA Says AI Spending Will More Than Double to $1.7 Trillion

articles.title: Google to Host Rival App Stores Inside Play Store Starting July 22
articles.excerpt: After six years of litigation with Epic Games, Google will allow third-party app stores to access its full US app catalog through a new Play Catalog Access Program, marking the biggest change to Android app distribution since the Play Store launched.

articles.title: Data Center Backlash Unites Americans Across Party Lines in Rare Bipartisan Revolt
articles.excerpt: From conservative rural Utah to liberal California, opposition to AI data centers has become one of the few issues uniting Democrats and Republicans, with 70% of Americans opposing local construction as New York halts new projects.

articles.title: Microsoft Unveils MDASH, an AI Security System That Outperforms Anthropic's Mythos in Vulnerability Detection

articles.title: HCLTech’s $1.14 Billion Mercedes-Benz Deal Lifts Indian IT Stocks Amid Mixed Q1 Earnings
